messages:
Nadia (new-hire): hey all, i'm Nadia, started yesterday. blocked on Console and feature-flag permissionsstaging admin + prod read would be ideal so i can shadow rollouts. who handles this? :wave:
Owen (platform): welcome Nadia! staging is a one-click for infra. prod read requires safety checklist + manager sign-off. what's your SSO email?
Nadia (new-hire): nadia@redwood.ai. my manager is Mira.
Mira (devex): confirming. Nadia will be shadowing the routing policy rollout this week so prod read-only is reasonable after the quick checklist.
Sam (people-ops): Nadia please open an access request ticket with: requested envs, justification, manager CC. paste the checklist items and i'll expedite once manager signs off.
sso-bot: SSO provisioning note: user nadia@redwood.ai provisioned at 2026-03-24T09:02:10Z.
Owen (platform): adding Nadia to `flags-staging-admins` and giving Console role `staging-operator` now. should show in ~30s.
Nadia (new-hire): got a notification. how do i confirm i can access the rollout page? any quick check?
Mira (devex): open Console -> Feature Flags -> Rollouts. if you see the "Start canary" button you have staging admin. or run: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/flags/rollouts` and check the JSON for permissions.
Nadia (new-hire): curl returns permissions for rollouts. thanks! filing the prod ticket now with checklist filled and Mira CC'd.
Sam (people-ops): got it. once Mira approves i'll flag it for security to review and then set prod read-only `flags-viewer`.
Mira (devex): approved in the ticket. note for Nadia: prod destructive ops require paired oncall. read-only is fine for shadowing.
Nadia (new-hire): noted. one more Q: is there a short cheatsheet for safe FF rollbacks? don't want to break anything while learning.
Mira (devex): yes, see the devex wiki link i pasted in the ticket: steps, rollback commands, and who to page. i also have a 5-min demo recorded. ping me for the link.
Nadia (new-hire): will do, thanks everyone for the quick help! :raised_hands:
Owen (platform): welcome aboard, reach out if roles don't stick after 5min caching window.
Sam (people-ops): done on my side once security clears. you should have staged access to learn and prod read within the day.
Nadia (new-hire): perfect, appreciate it.
